description: A sports-party crossover starring Mario and Sonic characters across more than 30 Olympic events. New Tokyo 2020 sports include skateboarding, surfing, karate and sport climbing, while ten retro 2D events recreate the 1964 Tokyo Olympics with classic-style Mario and Sonic visuals.

worldSummary: Tokyo 2020 venues host a broad collection of modern Olympic events, while story mode and special 2D events send Mario and Sonic characters into a stylized recreation of the 1964 Tokyo Games.

storyChapters.title: Final Olympic challenges
storyChapters.body: The two groups compete across events and reunite as the story resolves.
